Volunteer

For tasks big and small, HILT is always looking for energetic and enthusiastic volunteers. An essential component to the success of Hawai’i Land Trust, volunteers help with restoration and conservation projects, land stewardship, assist with events, complete office tasks, and collaborate on special projects.

No effort is too small. Your time, skills, and expertise help us advance our mission of "protecting, stewarding, and cultivating reciprocal relationships between people and ‘āina that sustain Hawaiʻi.” We welcome you to be part of the ‘ohana!

If you are interested in becoming a volunteer, see the available opportunities below or contact us to discuss your skills, talents and areas of interest.  We look forward to hearing from you!

Ho‘omoe wai kahi ke kao‘o. Let all travel together like water flowing in one direction. — ‘Ōlelo no‘eau

VOLUNTEER DAYS

Join us for Volunteer Days across the islands!  
Nothing beats being able to connect with nature and the opportunity to huli ka lima i lalo and work the soil.
